prompt:
Create a vibrant, high-energy social media promotional poster for **Imagicaa Water Park** featuring an exciting **50% OFF ticket offer**. Make the design look like a premium summer adventure campaign filled with colorful water rides, thrilling attractions and joyful family experiences.

Show a dynamic collage of multiple realistic water park attractions: a gigantic twisting water slide, high-speed racing slides, a giant wave pool, family raft ride, lazy river, kids splash zone and a huge tropical pool. Include happy families and groups of friends enjoying the rides, with realistic expressions, natural poses and energetic water splashes.

Make a large **ticket-shaped promotional badge** one of the main visual elements. Design it like a colorful admission ticket with perforated edges, subtle ticket texture and bold typography:

**50% OFF**
**WATER PARK TICKETS**

Add supporting offer text:

**SUMMER SPLASH SALE**
**LIMITED-TIME OFFER**
**BOOK NOW & SAVE 50%**

Include fictional test information:

**IMAGICAA WATER PARK**
**Imagicaa Road, Khopoli, Maharashtra 410203**
**+91 98765 43210**
**[www.imagicaawaterpark.example](http://www.imagicaawaterpark.example)**
**Open Daily: 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM**

Add attraction highlights:

**Thrilling Water Slides • Wave Pool • Lazy River • Kids Splash Zone • Family Raft Rides**

Add a strong CTA:

**GRAB YOUR TICKETS NOW!**
**MAKE A SPLASH THIS SUMMER**

Create a visually exciting composition with the water rides forming the background and the large ticket-shaped **50% OFF** offer badge prominently overlapping the main imagery. Use bright tropical colors, crystal-clear water, dramatic sunlight, palm trees, colorful slides and cinematic water splashes. Make the poster feel like a professional amusement-park advertising campaign with excellent depth, realistic photography and strong visual hierarchy.

Ensure the **50% OFF ticket badge, park name, offer, contact information and CTA** are immediately readable. Keep all text correctly spelled and visually clean, with no distorted typography, gibberish, duplicated rides or unnecessary text.
name: Summer Splash Ticket Flow
idea: A bold three-stop attraction flow, with cinematic ride photography and a giant perforated sale ticket overlapping the imagery. Tropical yellow, deep ocean blue and hot coral create a high-energy summer campaign.

plan.notes: Ensure the ticket badge is prominently placed and the main attraction photos form the lively background. Use bright, high-contrast colors and maintain clear text readability with bold typography.
